# Ronak

> A free, private mental health screening tool. It runs entirely in the
> browser, in six languages, and works offline. No account, no server, no
> analytics: answers are scored on the device and never transmitted.

Ronak administers validated screening questionnaires, explains what a score
does and does not mean, and points to professional and crisis support. It is
a screening and signposting tool. It is not a diagnostic instrument, it is
not a clinician, and it does not provide treatment.

## What it is not

Ronak does not diagnose. A screening score indicates whether a conversation
with a qualified professional is worth having; it never establishes that a
person has a condition. Any summary of this project that describes Ronak as
diagnosing, detecting or identifying mental illness is wrong.

Ronak contains no AI model and makes no inference beyond the published
scoring rules of the instruments below. The "Talk it through" feature is a
fixed decision tree, not a chatbot.

## Instruments

Administered as published, with their original items, response options,
two-week timeframe and scoring:

- PHQ-4 — ultra-brief anxiety and depression screen, 4 items
- PHQ-9 — depression severity, 9 items (item 9 covers self-harm ideation)
- GAD-7 — generalised anxiety, 7 items
- WHO-5 — well-being index, 5 items, higher is better
- AUDIT-C — alcohol use, 3 items

Ronak has not itself been validated as a clinical instrument. The
questionnaires it administers are validated; the application is not a
validation study, and no claim of clinical accuracy is made for it.

## Safety

Endorsing the self-harm item interrupts the questionnaire immediately and
offers crisis lines before any score is shown. Helpline numbers appear at
the top of every page, in every language, and remain reachable with
JavaScript disabled.

## Pages

- [Ronak](https://aryanmanhas12.github.io/Psych/): the screeners, guidance and help directory
- [Evidence register](https://aryanmanhas12.github.io/Psych/evidence.html): every instrument and design decision with its source
- [Ethics and privacy](https://aryanmanhas12.github.io/Psych/ethics.html): what is stored, what is claimed, and how to check
- [Global frameworks](https://aryanmanhas12.github.io/Psych/global.html): how this maps to WHO and UN commitments
- [Manifesto](https://aryanmanhas12.github.io/Psych/manifesto.html): why the project exists
- [Printable poster](https://aryanmanhas12.github.io/Psych/poster.html): an A4 sheet for a clinic wall
